Subject: Request: one-time proxy access for SOC 2 evidence (2027 period)

Hi Jonas,

We're kicking off fieldwork for Acme Health Systems and need temporary access to Redwood's SOC 2 Type II evidence for the 2027 audit period (Jan 1, 2027 - Dec 31, 2027).

Constraints:
- Our auditors are using a mix of Okta and local reviewers and for this engagement we cannot federate into your Okta (Acme uses a strict IdP flow).
- Ideally we need a one-time proxy or ephemeral reviewer link with download ability for a limited set of artifacts (SOC 2 report, control evidence bundles, and a handful of syslog extracts).
- Access window requested: 48-72 hours; target window May 10-11 (US PT preferred).

Can you advise the best way to provide this, and whether Redwood can also provide a signed bridge letter covering the report period if requested by the client?

Auditor lead:

Hi Lori — thanks for the heads up.

We can support a one-time, timeboxed reviewer session through the trust portal. A few clarifying questions so we scope permissions correctly:
1) Please confirm the list of individual auditor emails who need access (we need explicit names for the portal invite).
2) Do you require the ability to download files (ZIPs/PDFs), or is view-only sufficient for your procedures?
3) Which specific artifacts do you need from the evidence bundle (e.g., change-control tickets, IAM configs, EDR logs, backup runbooks)? The narrower the set the faster we can curate.

What we can offer:
- One-time reviewer link with MFA and IP allowlist; expiry can be set to 48 or 72 hours.
- Optionally provide a temporary reviewer credential if SSO is not possible (credentials are rotated and logged).
- Signed bridge letter available on request — we typically provide a short dated letter confirming no material changes since the report period and noting the audit range. We can prepare and have it signed by our security lead.

Kimberly / Marissa — can you take point on preparing the evidence extract (minimal set) and draft the bridge letter once Lori confirms scope?

Jonas
VP, Trust & Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
